acip: DE BZHIN GSHEGS PAS DGONGS SHING, DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA MTHONG BAR 'GYUR, LAS KYI SGRIB PA THAMS CAD RNAM PAR DAG PA'I SANGS RGYAS KYI ZHING DU SKYE BAR 'GYUR RO,
wylie: de bzhin gshegs pas dgongs shing, de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur, las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur ro
english: Those Gone Thus will turn their hearts to such people; they will be seen by Those Who Have Gone That Way.  And these people will be born into a Buddha paradise which is totally free of any kind of obstacle.
